cheats.name: Skip DRM authentication checkpoint
cheats.description: 하이브리드's second DRM checkpoint always faults: the auth-success handler indexes a state-constructor jump table with the response-buffer pointer instead of a small subtype id, so it jumps out of range. This forces subtype 3 (a valid constructor), so the success routine builds a working session and the title reaches gameplay. Works with the carrier auth completion that delivers the auth-success status (aram-authd).
cheats.author: aram

patches.note: success handler 0x1934: `movs r4,#3` instead of `adds r4,r1,#0`, so the state subtype is the valid jump-table index 3 rather than the response-buffer pointer
